identity.name: ZAGGLE PREPA OCEAN SER L
identity.industry: Fintech / Corporate Spend Management & Embedded Payments

summary.oneLiner: Zaggle delivered record FY26 growth (46% consolidated revenue, 51% EBITDA) driven by AI-accelerated product launches and strategic acquisitions (DICE, GreenEdge), shifting from high-cash-burn Propel models to high-margin SaaS and transaction-based revenue, with DICE’s 95% gross margin AI spend suite now core to its global expansion and margin expansion roadmap.

one-line thesis: Zaggle delivered record FY26 growth (46% consolidated revenue, 51% EBITDA) driven by AI-accelerated product launches and strategic acquisitions (DICE, GreenEdge), shifting from high-cash-burn Propel models to high-margin SaaS and transaction-based revenue, with DICE’s 95% gross margin AI spend suite now core to its global expansion and margin expansion roadmap.
financial scorecard: revenue: +46% YoY (consol INR1,908cr); EBITDA/margin: +51% YoY (consol INR192cr, 9.9% margin); PAT (rptd): +52% YoY (consol INR139cr); PAT (normalized): +52% YoY (no major distortions); order book: not disclosed; net debt: INR6cr net cash outflow (standalone), INR52cr negative (consol) due to nascent acquisitions and working capital build
guidance: revenue growth: 25-30% standalone, 40% consolidated FY27; margin: EBITDA guidance deferred pending DICE integration; order inflow: accelerating card activations (36k-40k annualized in 8 weeks); capex/commissioning: INR68cr asset purchase of DICE completed; no new capex guidance beyond DICE integration costs
segment / subsidiary detail: Propel: INR1,000cr+ GTV, 41% of revenue, margins down to 4% (Q4FY26) due to cash redemption model optimization; Zoyer: zero at IPO, now major growth driver with BROME module; SaaS: 2.2% of revenue, but DICE acquisition adds 95% gross margin AI SaaS; GreenEdge: INR103.7cr revenue in FY26 (+184% YoY), targeting 40-50% growth in FY27; Zagg.money: 36k-40k card annualized run rate; TaxSpanner: rebranding to Z.tax with AI copilot, cross-sell to Zagg.money users planned
growth verticals / optionality: Global expansion into UAE (go-live readiness maintained) and US (launch delayed to FY27 end); DICE’s enterprise client base offers cross-sell potential for cards and payments; AI-powered compliance SaaS enables entry into regulated global markets; potential for international M&A in spend management
margins & cost dynamics: EBITDA margin expanded to 9.9% (consol) on operating leverage and AI-driven efficiency; DICE acquisition adds 95% gross margin SaaS revenue; employee costs reduced due to AI automation; however, DICE integration will increase OpEx in Q1FY27; Propel margins pressured by cash redemption model, targeted to stabilize at 5.5%
capex / expansion: INR68cr asset purchase of DICE completed (down from INR123cr); capitalized R&D increased to INR56cr in H2FY26 (total FY26: INR107cr); no new capex guidance beyond DICE integration and AI product development
capital allocation: Prioritizing M&A (DICE, GreenEdge, Zagg.money) over organic growth; QIP proceeds to be deployed for strategic acquisitions; DICE acquisition structured as asset purchase to optimize cost and margin profile; cash flow optimization now prioritized over top-line growth in Propel segment
risks & watch-items: High trade receivables (INR129cr YoY increase); negative consolidated OCF (INR52cr); reliance on cash-back incentives for customer retention; geopolitical risk in UAE expansion; integration risk of DICE and 100+ new hires; margin compression in Propel if cash-back reduction impacts user retention
management quality / tone: Confident and transformational; focused on AI-led disruption, margin expansion, and cash flow discipline; openly acknowledging past cash burn in Propel and pivoting; optimistic on DICE’s SaaS margins and global expansion; tone is strategic, not reactive
non-obvious takeaways: DICE’s acquisition as an asset purchase (not equity) shifts all costs to Zaggle’s P&L, masking true standalone profitability until integration completes; 95% gross margin from DICE is pure SaaS — not transactional — making it a margin anchor; TaxSpanner’s rebrand to Z.tax with AI copilot is a stealth play to embed tax compliance into corporate spend workflows, creating a defensible moat
challenges → beneficiaries & losers:
| Challenge | Beneficiary/Loser | Dir | Conviction | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| High cash burn in Propel Points and negative consolidated OCF | Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited | beneficiary | High | DICE acquisition and AI automation are structurally improving margins and cash flow, turning a cash-negative model into a high-margin SaaS-led platform |
| Declining Propel margins and cash redemption model | Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited | beneficiary | High | Strategic shift away from cash-back incentives to transaction-based program fees will improve ROCE and free cash flow over 18-24 months |
| High trade receivables and working capital pressure | Zaggle Prepaid Ocean Services Limited | loser | Medium | INR129cr receivables remain a liquidity risk; if collection cycles don’t improve, it could constrain M&A capacity despite strong revenue growth |

themes.title: Digital platforms, SaaS, payments & cybersecurity
themes.need: Digital-public-infrastructure scale, enterprise SaaS and a compliance/security upcycle drive a distinct platform cohort. PINELABS/NPST/CMSINFO on payments; AURIONPRO/NEWGEN/NUCLEUS/ROUTE/TANLA on banking/CPaaS software; EMUDHRA/META(544441)/AURIONPRO on digital-identity & cybersecurity; CAPILLARY/MAPMYINDIA/NAZARA on SaaS/geospatial/gaming. Q1FY27 anchored the payments leg: PAYTM's GMV grew 31% YoY (accelerating 23% -> 27% -> 31%) with merchant payments about 80% of the financial-services mix and 25-30 lakh device additions a year on a distribution-only lending model (no book, no FLDG); MOBIKWIK posted payments GMV of INR 52,400cr (+58% YoY), a 13th consecutive record quarter and India's largest wallet by GTV at ~20% share, against only ~INR 3,200cr of digital-credit GMV. OFSS adds the banking-software annuity, with RPO +17% YoY versus revenue +7% and licence-and-cloud revenue +13% at a 44% operating margin.
themes.driver: Deal/ARR additions; festive digital-payments TPV; merchant-device additions; RBI/regulatory compliance-driven security spend.
